title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by UVEX Sports Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The anchor for the helmet's chinstrap can fail, causing the helmets to slide off the head, posing a head injury hazard. The bicycle helmets also do not comply with the impact requirements of the CPSC safety standards for bicycle helmets. Units: 46800.

summary: A defect in the line cord insulation poses a risk of electrical shock. Units: About 70.

summary: The play yard's rails can collapse, presenting a strangulation hazards to young children. Units: About 10,000.

title: Lenovo Recalls Computer Power Cords Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The AC power cord can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 500,000 in the U.S. and 44,000 in Canada.

title: Nordstrom Recalls Open Vest Sweaters Due to Burn Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The sweaters fail to meet the federal flammability standard for wearing apparel, posing a burn injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,030.

title: Horizon Hobby Recalls HobbyZone Super Cub S Radio-Controlled Aircraft Due to Fire Hazard

title: Daikin Recalls Air Purifiers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The air purifier's circuit board can overheat and cause the air purifier to catch on fire. Units: About 625 in the United States and 125 in Canada.

title: Eaton Recalls Electrical Meter Breakers Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The meter breaker's electrical components can be easily accessed, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,100.

summary: The frame of the bicycle could break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 150.

summary: Water can overheat during brewing, spray out and burn consumers. Units: About 6.6 million in the U.S. and 564,000 Canada.

summary: The battery compartment can reach temperatures up to 230 degrees Fahrenheit, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 13,000.

title: Schneider Electric Recalls PowerPact J-Frame Circuit Breakers Due to Fire, Burn, Electrical Shock Hazards
summary: The circuit breaker will not trip during an overload condition, posing a risk of fire, burns and electrical shock. Units: About 62,500.

title: Yamaha Recalls YZ250 Competition Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Risk of Injury, Death (Recall Alert)
summary: The engine can lock up during operation, causing a rider to lose control of the vehicle and crash, resulting in injuries and death. Units: About 875.

title: Wegmans Food Markets Recalls Moody Face Stress Balls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: These rubber stress balls can break into pieces when squeezed, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 7000.

title: WindowTex Recalls Custom Roller Shades Due to Risk of Injury
summary: A steel pin inserted into the idler on the shades can become dislodged and cause the shade to fall from the mounting bracket, posing a risk of injury from impact to the consumer. Units: About 6,800.

title: Olympic Mountain Products Recalls Tealight Wax Warmers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The tealights in the warmers can burn with an erratic or high flame, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 209,000 sets in the United States and 23,000 sets in Canada.
